round: # PRACTISE. Sorting. Every thing is spoken in English; the baskets are said in Dari and English.

intro_fa: دو سبد است: farmer دهقان و builder گلکار. هر چیز از کار کدام یک است؟
دو سبد است: yesterday دیروز و tomorrow فردا. جمله را گوش کن. اگر going to دارد، فردا است. اگر فعل گذشته دارد، دیروز است.

say_en: I am going to go to the bazaar.
She is going to cook rice.
We are going to play in the yard.
He is going to buy shoes.
I am going to read a book.

intro_fa: دو سبد است. صفت‌های کوتاه er می‌گیرند: bigger. صفت‌های دراز more می‌گیرند: more expensive. کلمه را بخوان و در سبد درست بینداز.
سه سبد است: شروع قصه، میان قصه و آخر قصه. جمله را گوش کن و فکر کن که در کجای قصه می‌آید.
say_en: One day a girl went to the river.
One day a fox was very hungry.
One day a farmer found a small bird.
One day a new family came to the village.
In the end everybody was happy.
In the end the baby slept.
Finally the two girls were friends again.

intro_fa: سه سبد است: دعوت، تشکر و معذرت. جملهٔ پیام را گوش کن و بگو که از کدام قسم است.
say_en: Please come to my house on Friday.
Can you come for dinner tonight?
Come and play with us tomorrow.
Please come and drink tea with us.
Thank you for the book. I like it.
I am sorry, I can't come because I am sick.
I am sorry I am late.
I am sorry I was angry yesterday.
I am sorry. I lost your notebook.
